_comment: Confusable sibling-tag groups for the ASL sibling-gap telemetry (todos/ASL_plan.md SS5). The metric only uses validation samples with EXACTLY ONE labeled tag per group (score of the labeled sibling minus max score among unlabeled siblings), so multi-membership (multicolored_hair, heterochromia, gradient_hair) never corrupts it and colors are NOT treated as exclusive. Tags missing from the vocabulary are skipped with a debug log.
